abstract: BACKGROUND: Primary cervical choriocarcinoma seen in a postmenopausal patient is a very rare entity. CASE: Primary choriocarcinoma of the uterine cervix was diagnosed in a 54-year-old woman. She had admitted to our clinic with vaginal bleeding and had been postmenopausal for 1 year at the time of diagnosis. A cervical tumoral mass was seen in her pelvic examination and cervical biopsy revealed squamous cell carcinoma of the cervix. Pelvic examination under anesthesia was done and patient was accepted as FIGO Stage IIA. Type III hysterectomy with bilateral salphingoopherectomy and bilateral pelvic-paraaortic lymph node dissection was carried out. Postoperative pathological evaluation of the surgical specimen showed that case was a primary choriocarcinoma of the cervix. CONCLUSION: This is one of the few reported cases of cervical choriocarcinoma in a postmenopausal patient. The most appropriate theory for the development of this tumor is metaplastic differentiation of the tumor from another histologic type.
abstract_ja: 背景：閉経後患者にみられる子宮頸部原発絨毛癌は、非常にまれな疾患である。症例：54歳女性で子宮頸部原発絨毛癌と診断された。膣出血を主訴に受診し、診断時には閉経後1年が経過していた。骨盤内診で子宮頸部に腫瘤を認め、子宮頸部生検で子宮頸部扁平上皮癌と診断された。麻酔下骨盤内診を施行し、FIGO病期IIAと判定された。III型子宮全摘術、両側付属器切除術、両側骨盤・傍大動脈リンパ節郭清を施行した。術後の病理学的評価で、本症例は子宮頸部原発絨毛癌であることが判明した。結論：閉経後患者にみられる子宮頸部絨毛癌の報告例は少数である。本腫瘍の発生機序として最も妥当なのは、他の組織型からの化生性分化であるとの説がある。
